tests: Secure Boot Test - Customized Deployment Basic Test

pre_test_commands.desc: Clear stale Secure Boot manual popup state
pre_test_commands.guest_run: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual' -Force | Out-Null; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual\request.json', 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual\ack.json', 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual\round_id.txt', 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual\prepare_attempted.txt', 'C:\AutoHCK\SecureBootManual\ufd2_msft.json' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0

pre_test_commands.desc: Set iospy StartOverride for Secure Boot Manual Logo Test
pre_test_commands.guest_run: reg.exe add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\iospy\StartOverride /v 0 /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to set iospy StartOverride' }

pre_test_commands.desc: Set MSDMFilt StartOverride for Secure Boot Manual Logo Test
pre_test_commands.guest_run: reg.exe add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\MSDMFilt\StartOverride /v 0 /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to set MSDMFilt StartOverride' }

pre_test_commands.desc: Upload Secure Boot manual popup watcher
Set Secure Boot watcher to start on any user logon and reboot to activate
pre_test_commands.guest_run: $autoit = if (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files (x86)\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe') { 'C:\Program Files (x86)\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe' } else { 'C:\Program Files\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $autoit)) { throw 'AutoIt is not installed on CL01' }; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'AutoHCK_SecureBootManualWatcher' -Value ('"{0}" "{1}"' -f $autoit, 'C:\UIAgent\autoit\secure_boot_manual_watcher.au3') -PropertyType String -Force

post_test_commands.desc: Stop Secure Boot manual popup watcher
post_test_commands.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'AutoHCK_SecureBootManualWatcher' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'AutoIt3*.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*secure_boot_manual_watcher.au3*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0

pre_test_commands.desc: Set HSP watcher to start on any user logon and reboot to activate
pre_test_commands.guest_run: $autoit = if (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files (x86)\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe') { 'C:\Program Files (x86)\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe' } else { 'C:\Program Files\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe' }; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'AutoHCK_UIWatcher' -Value ('"{0}" "{1}"' -f $autoit, 'C:\UIAgent\autoit\hsp_watcher.au3') -PropertyType String -Force

post_test_commands.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'AutoHCK_UIWatcher' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Name AutoIt3 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0
